name: Expedited curtailable study
desc: Fast-track the study of loads and hybrids that agree to be curtailable and dispatchable.

letters.desc: AEMA endorses an expedited interconnection path for loads committing to curtailability, aligned with the ANOPR's Principle 7 and the SPP High Impact Large Load precedent. Study transparency on constraints is a prerequisite for loads to make informed curtailability commitments.
quotes: AEMA urges the Commission to create a Flexible Load Fast Track (FLFT) for facilities that can verifiably adjust their consumption in response to system conditions and harness a broad set of technologies to deliver flexibility to the grid.

The FLFT would be an expedited (60-90 day) interconnection process for loads that commit to flexibility and would incorporate this flexibility into studies that determine whether transmission grid upgrades are necessary to interconnect the load.

The Commission should direct transmission providers to treat this verifiable reduction as equivalent to a system-impact mitigation, allowing such projects to be studied and interconnected on a shorter timeline.

To comply with Principle 7 of the ANOPR and for large loads to decide whether they can be curtailable, transmission owners and RTOs must provide transparency during the study process regarding the specific constraints that a large load would create and the frequency and amount of curtailment that would be necessary.

letters.desc: AEMA supports expedited study and interconnection pathways for loads that commit to curtailment. The filing rejects discrimination claims, arguing that loads with different system impacts rightly receive different treatment, and that a curtailable load simply does not need the same network upgrades as a firm load.
quotes: flexible load capabilities should be leveraged to bridge the gap between immediate interconnection needs and the longer timelines required for traditional transmission upgrades, accelerating AI infrastructure investments while also deferring or avoiding upgrades that can raise costs for ratepayers.

It is a fundamental principle of interconnection policy that customers who impose different impacts on the system should be treated differently. A load that is legally and technically bound to curtail during constraints does not require the same network upgrades as a static, inflexible load.

letters.desc: Advanced Energy United endorses expedited interconnection for flexible or curtailable loads but insists the pathway be strictly voluntary and tightly bounded. It also calls for non-firm transmission options as a parallel benefit for loads that accept flexibility obligations.
quotes: This means (1) this expedited pathway should not confer the same interconnection service as is available to interconnection customers serving native load, and (2) this pathway should be available only to generation or storage resources that are not similarly situated to other interconnection customers in that they meet eligibility parameters that meaningfully, transparently, and objectively differentiate projects that proceed via expedited pathways from projects in the general queue.

New large loads willing to operate without firm transmission access—either permanently on a temporary basis as network upgrades are planned and constructed—should have clearly defined, optional, and expedited pathways to do so.

letters.desc: AES backs expedited action across all supply options, including generation, battery storage, demand response, curtailment, and grid-enhancing technologies, to keep pace with large-load demand growth.
quotes: To meet the unprecedented demand growth over the next decade, AES believes that Commission focus is needed on expediting all possible solutions (including generation and battery capacity, demand response, targeted curtailment, and grid enhancing technologies).

letters.desc: Alliant Energy endorses expedited study treatment for curtailable large loads but opposes mandatory demand response program participation. It recommends bilateral agreements between customers and transmission providers that define curtailment amounts, notice periods, and duration, giving flexibility to qualify for expedited study without rigid program constraints.
quotes: Expedited interconnection processes like ERAS—not netting—are the right solution to integrate large loads efficiently and maintain a robust, reliable grid.
curtailable large loads should not be required to participate in a mandatory formal demand response program as it would unnecessarily hinder and discourage innovative solutions.
Alliant Energy recommends that the Commission allow for flexible, bilateral agreements between large load customers and transmission providers.

letters.desc: Amazon Energy recommends Order No. 2023-style mechanisms to prioritize ready projects and a fast-track for high-readiness large loads. It urges the Commission to incentivize or require transmission providers to use advanced grid modeling and AI-driven analysis to speed feasibility and system impact studies, while stressing that automation supports rather than replaces engineering judgment.
quotes: Amazon Energy recommends that any rule adopted by the Commission governing the interconnection of large loads include mechanisms like those in Order No. 2023 to prioritize projects that are ready for interconnection.

Amazon Energy encourages the Commission to include in any rule a "fast track" or priority processing track for large load projects that can demonstrate a high degree of readiness (e.g., projects that have (i) committed customers, (ii) secured all necessary permits, (iii) site control, (iv) secured financing or corporate commitments, and/or (v) an executed service agreement).
Amazon Energy encourages the Commission to leverage technology and process innovations to automate and accelerate large load interconnections.

The Commission should incentivize or require transmission providers to deploy modern software tools, such as advanced grid modeling and AI-driven analysis, that can conduct feasibility and system impact studies more expeditiously and efficiently.

Amazon Energy emphasizes that greater automation is not a substitute for sound engineering judgment, but a way to expedite engineers' and planners' work by handling administratively burdensome tasks and analyses in hours or days rather than weeks or months.

letters.desc: ACC sees load flexibility and permitting streamlining as urgent near-term solutions to grid stress, with curtailment alone potentially unlocking 126 GW of additional capacity while long-term infrastructure builds.
quotes: if large loads can commit to just a 1% curtailment rate, equivalent to only a few offline days per year, it could unlock around 126 GW of additional capacity on the grid
streamlining the siting and permitting of high-voltage, interregional transmission lines and generation resources, must proceed alongside near-term solutions, like those proposed in this ANOPR

letters.desc: AEP supports exploring expedited interconnection tools such as conditional service for curtailable loads, advanced conductor reconductoring, and consolidated planning processes that shorten study timelines. These should complement, not replace, longer-term infrastructure solutions.
quotes: Temporary conditional service is a short-term speed-to-power solution that can bring new generation and load on line quickly and be used as a bridge service until the transmission system is upgraded to support full network service to those interconnections.
If large loads are willing to accept conditional transmission service and be curtailed, the Commission could adopt rules that allow LSEs to bring large loads online faster.
Reconductoring with advanced conductors can greatly increase capacity in a short time frame (less than two years), utilizing existing towers and rights-of-way, thereby avoiding siting processes.

letters.desc: American Terawatt says traditional large-load interconnection takes five to eight years and asks FERC to direct ISOs and RTOs to create expedited interconnection processes and enabling tariffs for defined large flexible loads.
quotes: American Terawatt urges the Commission to focus swiftly and pragmatically on reforms that can be adopted without delay and that will encourage the timely expansion of digital and energy infrastructure.

Traditional interconnection of large loads averages five years, and often up to eight years throughout the country. Our ability to bring compute for AI online is severely constrained by the availability of power.

Data-center developers willing to build flexible AI factories or retrofit existing sites with flexible load capabilities should have access to a significantly accelerated grid interconnection process.
FERC should direct independent system operators (ISOs) to develop expedited interconnection processes for defined large flexible loads, with transparent criteria.

FERC should direct regional transmission organizations and ISOs to propose enabling, nondiscriminatory tariffs for participation in expedited interconnection processes for defined large flexible loads.

letters.desc: Arevia seeks expedited interconnection studies for hybrid facilities whose generation component can be curtailed or dispatched.
quotes: If the generating component of the hybrid facility is capable of being curtailable and/or dispatchable, then the combined load and generation facilities should be expedited.

letters.desc: The filer supports expedited interconnection pathways for loads and hybrid facilities that commit to verifiable dispatchability. SPP's HILLGA model is cited as a concrete example where expedited processing pairs with combined generation-load applications when facilities are electrically proximal.
quotes: The Commission should encourage mechanisms, such as expedited interconnection, to incentivize voluntary participation by large loads that choose to make their operations available as dispatchable system assets

Under the HILLGA process, supplemental generating facilities procured to serve such loads may be considered in a combined application with the load, expediting interconnection, when located electrically proximal, defined as no more than two bulk-system substations away from the load.
large loads…and hybrid facilities that agree to be curtailable and dispatchable should be expedited.
establishing clear incentives for dispatchable performance is an appropriate and effective means of enhancing system reliability

letters.desc: Bloom supports expedited interconnection studies and a 90-day timeline. It urges FERC to extend expedited access beyond curtailable/dispatchable facilities to those with primary power sufficient to cover full peak load.
quotes: The ANOPR presents a major leap forward for interconnecting on-site generation and load as a composite resource.  The Commission should act expeditiously in adopting interconnection reforms.
Bloom urges the Commission to expand expedited studies to include hybrid facilities having primary power sufficient to meet its peak load.

The ANOPR seemingly takes the position that agreement by a hybrid facility to be dispatchable and curtailable is the "grand bargain" for expedited interconnection studies, but it should not be the only way to receive expedited studies.

Consistent with existing reliability study requirements for Surplus Interconnection Service, a 90-day period to study hybrid facilities seems reasonable, provided requested withdrawal and injection rights do not identify the need for additional reliability studies to determine if Network Upgrades are required.

letters.desc: Interconnection studies for loads and hybrid facilities agreeing to be curtailable or dispatchable should be expedited, potentially to 60 days, enabling timely and orderly system additions.
quotes: Calibrant Energy Holdings, LLC ("Calibrant") supports the action taken by Secretary Wright to address the interconnection of large loads. The letter appropriately recognizes the benefits of large load flexibility and recommends an expedited interconnection study process for loads that are curtailable or co-located with generation or energy storage.

letters.desc: CAISO supports expedited treatment for curtailable and dispatchable loads but recommends the final rule create distinct tiers based on the full scope of dispatch tools available. Partial curtailability should not qualify for the same treatment as fully curtailable facilities.
quotes: The CAISO recommends that any final rule should establish distinct 'lanes' based on the level of dispatch tools the transmission provider will have--all, some, or none.

being curtailable on some hours or on some days or for only a portion of the load or generating capacity should not allow a facility to avail itself of the same expedited process as completely curtailable facilities.

letters.org: CHAMBER OF COMMERCE OF THE UNITED STATES
letters.desc: The Chamber wants the Commission to move quickly on its pending colocation proceeding so a holistic, coordinated approach across related rulemakings is in place.
quotes: the Commission should promptly finalize its pending proceeding regarding the colocation of generation with such large loads. A holistic approach is necessary

letters.desc: Chevron endorses FERC openness to regional fast-track proposals from SPP, MISO, and PJM as a bridge to connect large loads and generation before national standards are finalized in all regions.
quotes: The Commission should be open to such regional fast-track proposals, which may provide mechanisms to connect large loads and generation before DOE ANOPR standards can be practicably established in all regions.

letters.desc: AI-SCA frames faster interconnection as a national security and economic development imperative and calls on FERC to act promptly to establish procedures that outperform current timelines.
quotes: Reducing interconnection timelines is now a national security and economic development imperative.

Meeting the growing demand from new, critical large loads requires accelerating interconnection processes and establishing additional pathways for large loads to connect to the transmission system in ways that manage costs and preserve long-term reliability for all customers.

Timely interconnection to the transmission system via existing sites with power and opportunities to quickly develop new and additional power supplies is paramount to meeting national security and economic development goals.

members of the AI-SCA encourage the Commission to act expeditiously in support of open and non-discriminatory access to the transmission system and standardization of interconnection procedures and agreements for large loads to support economic growth and competition.

letters.desc: Constellation supports expediting interconnection studies for curtailable and dispatchable loads and endorses allowing interruptible transmission service as a bridge while firm upgrades are completed. It also supports extending the option to build to large load customers.
quotes: While expediting the interconnection studies of flexible load is a good step, the Commission should endorse other paths that would allow curtailable large loads and dispatchable hybrid resources to connect without first requiring the completion of system upgrades needed to support firm transmission service at peak, and without requiring any additional capacity.

the Commission should immediately order the following: PJM must establish a timeline -- with milestones -- for the completion of load interconnection studies for hybrid in-front-of-the-meter configurations ... with an absolute study completion deadline, including Transmission Owner input, of six months.
Constellation agrees that the option to build should be provided to large load customers subject to host utility standards as it is currently provided to generator interconnection customers.

letters.desc: Constellation urges FERC to act quickly, calling for a PJM merits order by year-end and a NOPR by April 2026. It supports PJM Option 7 for curtailable loads and opposes BYOG proposals that would grant expedited treatment only to loads that bring new generation.
quotes: the Commission should issue a Notice of Proposed Rulemaking ("NOPR") that builds upon the principles in the ANOPR and responds to the four areas of consensus. The NOPR should: (i) establish deadlines to meet the Secretary's timeline for a final rule by April 30, 2026; (ii) solicit specific evidence of unjust and unreasonable service for large loads and/or undue discrimination or preference by Transmission Owners to support the Commission's required Federal Power Act ("FPA") section 206 showing in each region and state

the Commission should reject "Bring Your Own Generation" or "BYOG" proposals (such as PJM Option 6 in the Show Cause proceeding) that would allow state-favored resources to leapfrog the PJM queue, and should likewise reject proposals discussed in the ANOPR comments or in the IMM's recent complaint that would condition new large load interconnections (or expedited interconnection) upon the load bringing its own new generation.

letters.desc: Constellation asks FERC to allow LCEP requests to be processed outside the standard interconnection queue on an expedited basis, similar to Surplus Interconnection Service, to address years-long delays facing large loads.
quotes: LCEP Service as outlined here and in Attachment A is just and reasonable and not unduly discriminatory or preferential. Like Surplus Interconnection Service, LCEP Service is an expedited interconnection process outside of the standard interconnection queue for new generation paired with new load at sites with existing generation facilities that have already been studied.
The LCEP Proposal is animated by and can achieve the goal of speed to power for large load projects stymied today by extremely long interconnection timelines.

letters.desc: Critical Loop asks for a 60-day binding initial determination for all large-load requests, giving developers a provisional queue position while full studies proceed. It also supports recognizing BESS bridge operation as a fast-permitting, low-impact path to accelerate time-to-power.
quotes: A 60‑day requirement for all large‑load requests should provide a binding initial determination that includes a limited‑load capacity profile, identified constraints and telemetry, and a provisional queue position so developers can plan and finance while full engineering studies continue

Recognize BESS‑enabled bridge operation as a low‑impact path that can permit faster than new combustion generation, improves power quality and ride‑through for large loads, and buys time while export or transmission upgrades for new generation proceed

letters.desc: Critical Loop argues that loads that commit to LLFC arrangements and bring their own capacity should receive expedited treatment in queues and resource-adequacy frameworks. The filing asks for an initial determination within 60 days of submission and treats speed-to-power as a core national-competitiveness metric.
quotes: for many large loads, time-to-power is the binding constraint. Interconnection queues are severely backlogged, and new transmission and generation are often contentious to permit and develop.

Large loads should pay the costs they cause, and they should receive appropriate treatment, including access to expedited, flexible interconnection pathways and transparent queue treatment, when they verifiably reduce needed system investments and help lower long-run costs for other ratepayers through LLFC-style commitments and bring-your-own-capacity arrangements.

Critical Loop urges the Commission instead to treat speed-to-power as a core reliability and national-competitiveness metric. If AI clusters and advanced manufacturing facilities cannot secure timely interconnections in the United States, investments may migrate to jurisdictions with more agile interconnection frameworks, with long-term implications for national security, supply-chain resilience, and economic leadership.

letters.desc: Crusoe favors fast-track interconnection for curtailable loads but insists that applicants must prove actual technical curtailment ability. Giving expedited treatment to unproven technologies would create new inefficiencies.
quotes: it is critical that companies must demonstrate actual technical ability to curtail loads and advance flexible computing to be eligible for expedited interconnection.  If there are no stringent requirements for flexible load, the Commission could inadvertently create inefficiencies if unproven technologies are prioritized and expedited.

letters.desc: DCC supports expedited interconnection study for configurations that deliver demonstrable grid benefits, and argues that expedited pathways should not be limited to curtailable loads since operational requirements may preclude curtailability.
quotes: Support exists for creating expedited pathways for configurations that provide demonstrable grid benefits, with many commenters emphasizing the need for such pathways to accommodate the diverse operational profiles of large loads.

expedited processes should not be limited to curtailable loads, as this may be incompatible with operational requirements, and that coordination of new load and incremental generation alone warrants expedited study.

letters.desc: DEC supports an incentive-based, voluntary fast-track interconnection process for flexible loads, conditional on verifiable curtailment commitments, with publicly posted timelines and corrective actions for missed deadlines.
quotes: DEC supports the Department's initiative and encourages the Commission to establish a transparent, performance-based framework that recognizes flexibility as a grid resource, accelerates access to transmission, and ensures reliability and fairness for all users.
The Commission should direct transmission providers to establish a voluntary, incentive-based fast-track process for customers that commit to verifiable flexibility agreements.

letters.desc: DPN calls expedited study for curtailable and dispatchable facilities essential and wants even higher priority for operators with a proven curtailment and dispatch track record over new entrants.
quotes: the interconnection study of large loads that agree to be curtailable and hybrid facilities that agree to be curtailable and dispatchable should be expedited.
There also needs to be an even higher priority for company submissions that have proven their ability to curtail / dispatched at their facilities vs. new entries.

letters.desc: EDF requests a firm expedited interconnection timeline, potentially as short as 60 days, for curtailable loads and dispatchable hybrid facilities, and asks that the backlog of PUHCA declaratory orders be replaced with an automatic exemption process given how long individual filings take.
quotes: It would be burdensome for every IPP that is currently an EWG, or future IPPs that would otherwise qualify for EWG status, to have to file a petition for declaratory order to maintain an exemption from PUHCA's requirements.  The time for the Commission to act on an individual petition for declaratory order has recently ranged from 82 days to nearly 6 months

The Commission should fast-track curtailable loads and curtailable/dispatchable hybrid facilities with firm expedited timelines.  Given that curtailable load and dispatchable generation at hybrid facilities can be beneficial and useful to day-to-day grid operations, interconnection timelines should be significantly reduced – in some cases to as little as 60 days.

letters.desc: EEI supports extending any accelerated study benefits to load-generation arrangements that are electrically proximate but not at the same point of interconnection, citing the SPP HILL/HILLGA model as an example.
quotes: the Commission should extend accelerated study benefits—if any are established in a Final Rule—to arrangements involving load and facilities located in proximity to each other but not at the same point of interconnection.

letters.desc: EEI points to SPP's conditional transmission service proposal as an example of expedited interconnection tools that allow High Impact Large Load customers to connect quickly while protecting the grid.
quotes: A new SPP proposal to create conditional transmission service to integrate High Impact Large Load customers quickly.

letters.desc: EPSA strongly supports expedited interconnection study processes for curtailable and dispatchable loads. It calls for concurrent, time-bound study timelines across ISOs, RTOs, and transmission owners rather than serial processes that have historically caused delay.
quotes: EPSA firmly agrees that, when a large load customer agrees to be curtailable and dispatchable in order to assist in system reliability and flexibility in defined circumstances, that load should be subject to an expedited interconnection study process.
the Commission should direct ISOs/RTOs to complete studies within a specific time – bundled on a concurrent timeline with any transmission owner studies to the extent possible.

letters.desc: ELCON supports offering expedited interconnection study to loads that commit to being curtailable or dispatchable. The Commission must define those terms precisely, including how much, when, and how curtailment applies, to make the commitments enforceable.
quotes: ELCON appreciates the flexibility provided by principles five through seven to study load interconnection requests according to their operational needs and allow for expedited study for those customers agreeing to be curtailable and/or dispatchable.
the Commission should implement safeguards that clearly define "curtailable" and "dispatchable" including details of how much, when, and how in order to enforce those commitments.

letters.desc: ECA strongly supports faster interconnection for loads providing curtailment or flexibility. It proposes an added guideline requiring interconnection processes to be completed within two years under normal circumstances, with a faster track for flexible loads.
quotes: developing a full set of pro forma interconnection procedures and a pro forma agreement that can be applied nationwide will be exceedingly difficult if not impossible to accomplish by the April 30, 2026 date set by the Secretary for "final action."

ECA suggests that the Commission propose and seek comment on an additional guideline requiring that transmission providers demonstrate that their large load interconnection procedures will result in reasonable interconnection timelines.

ECA suggests a guideline requiring that transmission providers have in place a large load interconnection process that, under normal circumstances, can be completed in two years, with an exception for large load customers that provide flexibility or take other steps to limit the need for infrastructure upgrades (which, consistent with the seventh principle in the ANOPR, should be significantly faster).

ECA strongly agrees that large load customers that agree to be flexible or provide curtailment that reduces the need for extensive network upgrades should receive the benefit of faster interconnection timelines.

letters.desc: Emerald AI supports a fast-track study path with a 60 to 90 day approval timeline for loads that demonstrate verifiable flexibility thresholds. It argues that performance-based software verification provides the same reliability signal as physical control, justifying the expedited treatment.
quotes: We are particularly supportive of Principle 7 and urge the Commission to create a "Flexible Load Fast Track" (FLFT) that rewards verifiable flexibility with what large loads value most: faster and larger interconnections for new facilities seeking swift access and existing facilities seeking larger and speedy capacity to upgrade to latest-generation computing technology.

The Commission should instead adopt a performance-based definition of flexibility, consistent with the shift toward performance-based standards seen in other areas of grid regulation. If a facility can demonstrate, through telemetry and secure software interfaces, that it will reduce its withdrawal from 100 MW to 75 MW within the required timeframe of a signal, it effectively provides the same reliability value as a physical breaker, but with vastly higher economic efficiency.
Emerald AI strongly recommends this be defined as a secure, standardized, and auditable software interface, not direct, physical utility control.

the FLFT would allow facilities meeting defined flexibility thresholds to receive interconnection approval within 60 to 90 days, based on verification of available firm capacity and demonstration of control and telemetry systems.

letters.desc: Emerald AI supports expedited interconnection pathways for data centers that can verifiably reduce load through software orchestration, without requiring generation buildouts as a precondition.
quotes: Building new generation is capital-intensive and delay projects by several years. Software-defined flexibility can be deployed immediately.
Mandating that data centers build matching generation to receive expedited interconnection is economically inefficient and technologically regressive.

letters.desc: Enchanted Rock recommends expedited interconnection processes for large loads paired with generation or willing to operate under non-firm service, operating in parallel with prevailing queues. SPP models like HILLGA and CHILLS should be adopted by other grid operators.
quotes: the Commission should consider making large load facilities paired with generation, or large load facilities willing to participate under non-firm service, eligible for an expedited interconnection process.

Efforts such as Southwest Power Pool, Inc. ('SPP')'s High Impact Large Load Generation Assessment ('HILLGA') and anticipated Conditional High Impact Large Load Service ('CHILLS') proposal are examples of proposals that will create expedited pathways for interconnecting large loads.

letters.desc: The filer cites SPP's HILLGA assessment and anticipated CHILLS proposal as examples of expedited large-load interconnection pathways the Commission should consider as models for other grid operators.
quotes: Efforts such as Southwest Power Pool, Inc. (“SPP”)’s High Impact Large Load Generation Assessment (“HILLGA”) and anticipated Conditional High Impact Large Load Service (“CHILLS”) proposal are examples of proposals that will create expedited pathways for interconnecting large loads.

letters.org: Enerwise Global Technologies, LLC dba CPower
letters.desc: Large loads that bring load flexibility should qualify for expedited interconnection. The filing expands the concept to include loads that arrange flexibility through appropriately sited resources, not just self-provided curtailment.
quotes: Load flexibility can be deployed much more quickly than new generation because no interconnection process or lengthy construction period applies to load flexibility that uses an already installed behind the meter asset or does not use a behind the meter asset at all.

Principle seven states that 'the interconnection study of large loads that agree to be curtailable and hybrid facilities that agree to be curtailable and dispatchable should be expedited.' The Joint Parties agree with this principle but ask that it be expanded to state that large loads that agree to be curtailable or that arrange for load flexibility with an appropriately sited resource be entitled to an expedited interconnection process.

letters.desc: ENGIE supports a separate expedited queue for curtailable and dispatchable hybrid facilities that bring their own generation or storage. It warns that flexibility parameters (notice, percentage, duration, frequency) must be defined or projects will be commercially unfinanceable.
quotes: ENGIE supports the concept of expedited interconnection for these types of facilities where load brings its own generation and/or storage. ENGIE recommends that the Commission consider establishing a separate queue for this purpose.

If these requirements are left unparameterized a project will struggle with commercial feasibility. It is next to impossible for a facility to plan around the requirements and there is almost no way to finance facilities that are exposed to these types of undefined risks.

letters.desc: Entergy supports a limited federal backstop that gives large loads procedural recourse only when state processes stall for an unreasonable time, preserving flexibility for transmission providers to tailor studies to their systems. It opposes extending expedited treatment broadly to hybrid facilities without adequate reliability analysis.
quotes: the Commission should consider establishing a backstop role, so that if load interconnection procedures are stalled for an unreasonable period of time, a large load has clear procedural recourse
A backstop rule would also enable transmission providers to exercise necessary flexibility and judgment in formulating the studies and procedures that are best suited to their systems.
it is premature to assume that the breadth of hybrid options proposed by various commenters should all be entitled to expedited interconnection study or that expedited study is feasible

letters.desc: Eolian proposes a serial streamlined study process for qualifying hybrid facilities that can complete in 60 to 90 days per transmission owner by avoiding deliverability analysis where operating limits eliminate the need for network upgrades. This contrasts with the multi-year timelines that currently impede large load interconnection.
quotes: each transmission owner can independently conduct streamlined hybrid interconnection processes (even within an ISO/RTO region) in serial fashion in as little as 60-90 days.

letters.desc: Eolian strongly supports expedited, streamlined study for curtailable and dispatchable facilities, noting broad record support from large loads, developers, utilities, and states. It frames expedited study as appropriate because curtailable facilities cause fewer system impacts and can be studied outside the standard queue without triggering restudies.
quotes: The establishment of a non-firm network transmission service tier should be a core part of any final rule, as such a service tier is integral to enabling transmission providers to expedite interconnection for curtailable large loads and curtailable and dispatchable hybrid facilities.

just as an express checkout line appropriately rewards those whose needs can be addressed more quickly with faster service, it is appropriate to study curtailable and dispatchable facilities on a separate, streamlined basis due to their lesser impacts on the broader system

letters.desc: esVolta supports an expedited interconnection process for large loads paired with BESS, referencing both the 12 to 18 month BESS deployment advantage and the curtailability test as grounds for that treatment. It explicitly endorses a 90-day expedited study window in MISO.
quotes: If an ANOPR is issued, it should seek to include a proposal that articulates core principles, such as studying large loads and hybrid facilities together with generation where practicable, recognizing curtailable and dispatchable configurations (including those supported by BESS) for expedited treatment, and aligning cost responsibility with the specific injection and withdrawal rights requested.

Battery energy storage is a proven solution to meeting near-term and longer-term resource adequacy and reliability needs, with a modular design that can be right sized based on need, and one of the shortest construction time frames of any resource (12-18 months).
BESS enables the large loads to be curtailable or flexible and should jointly be eligible for an expedited pathway to interconnection.

esVolta encourages the Commission to consider a similar approach in any rulemaking it promulgates to address the integration of large loads and ensure that standalone BESS either located "in close proximity", "near by" the data center, or either electrically or co-located onsite with the data center or the large load is deemed an eligible supply resource to receive expedited interconnection study treatment along with the data center load.

esVolta would go even further to support approaches in PJM that rightfully identify supply resources in the same "load deliverability area or LDA" as an eligible resource for the expedited interconnection process and similarly, in MISO, standalone storage and other resources that have agreements with large loads to provide needed resources and are located in the same "local resource zone or LRZ" should be deemed eligible for an expedited interconnection process completed within 90 days.

letters.desc: Eversource supports an expedited study process for large loads under time pressure or access to state retail processes. It reports its customers show no interest in mandatory dispatchable curtailment, suggesting eligibility be tied to voluntary curtailment instead.
quotes: The Commission could also create an expedited study process for all large loads under significant time pressure, or allow those loads to avail themselves of state retail processes.
none of its current or prospective large load customers have expressed any interest in mandatory/dispatchable curtailment.

letters.desc: Fervo supports expedited interconnection studies for hybrid facilities that offer operational flexibility (curtailability or dispatchability), as these characteristics reduce system impacts and accelerate deployment of clean firm resources.
quotes: Fervo supports the Commission's proposal to expedite interconnection studies for large loads and hybrid facilities that agree to be curtailable or dispatchable, as these operational flexibilities materially reduce system impacts and allow transmission providers to study such projects with greater confidence.

An expedited study process that recognizes the reliability value of curtailable or dispatchable hybrids would help accelerate deployment of clean firm resources while allowing transmission providers to prioritize projects that offer the greatest operational benefit.

letters.desc: FirstEnergy supports an expedited interconnection track for projects meeting technical, financial, and permitting milestones, consistent with PJM's proposed framework and Order No. 2023 clustering principles. This would clear speculative projects and reduce backlogs.
quotes: The Commission should consider reforms in this proceeding that allow interconnection-ready projects to timely advance through the queue, similar to PJM Interconnection, L.L.C.'s ("PJM") consideration of rules for an expedited interconnection track for the interconnection of data centers and other large loads.

By allowing projects that meet defined technical, financial, and permitting milestones to proceed ahead of other less-developed requests, transmission providers can reduce unnecessary delays and lower the queue backlog.
Implementation and administration of an option to build for large load data center customers will add significant delay and risk to their proposed interconnections.

letters.desc: Fluence supports an expedited interconnection pathway for curtailable and flexible large loads, contending that BESS uniquely enables load flexibility and that hybrid facilities including BESS should qualify for faster processing.
quotes: BESS is uniquely positioned to make large loads curtailable and flexible.
Given these highly desired attributes, the interconnection of hybrid facilities that include BESS should be expedited.

letters.desc: The GPSC describes its ability to quickly engage with prospective customers on resource type, load flexibility, and rate design as evidence that state-level processes can move fast enough to accommodate large load growth.
quotes: The GPSC is able to support this economic development through engagement with businesses looking to locate in Georgia to ensure that the size and types of resources, opportunities for load flexibility, and rate designs meet the desired specifications.

letters.desc: Google supports an expedited interconnection track for loads that bring new proximate generation or offer verified flexibility, with a 90-day study timeline. The expedited track should be an incentive tied to verifiable financial commitments.
quotes: The coordinated and expedited study of electrically proximate large loads and grid-connected generators will facilitate the development of digital infrastructure while minimizing the strain on, and maximizing the use of, existing power infrastructure.

The Commission should craft procedures to expedite the transmission-level interconnection of new load and electrically proximate generation where a large load developer makes a financial commitment, via a power purchase agreement ('PPA') or a similar agreement, to bring online a new generating facility, uprate or expand an existing generating facility, retain a generating facility that would otherwise retire, or enable a resource that would otherwise be uneconomic to undergo fuel-switching.

The Commission should establish a firm timeline for these and similar interconnection studies.  Google proposes a 90-day study timeline, which is consistent with recent expedited interconnection procedures approved by the Commission.

letters.desc: Google urges the Commission to act promptly to create expedited interconnection pathways for co-located, electrically proximate, and curtailable configurations. Study timelines of 90 days and defined negotiation windows are recommended.
quotes: Google agrees with commenters that the Commission should establish pathways for facilitating the expedited study and interconnection of electrically proximate pairs of generation and load, as doing so will reduce the network upgrades needed to interconnect new resources, which can accelerate the pace at which new generation comes online.

combining flexible grid connections with a "bring-your-own-capacity" framework in PJM could shorten interconnection wait times by three to five years and maintain grid power availability for over 99% of hours, while requiring on-site resource dispatch for only 40 to 70 hours annually.

letters.org: Governor Josh Shapiro and Governor Glenn Youngkin
letters.desc: The governors support the position, shared with thirteen bipartisan governors, that interconnection requests taking longer than six months should not be deemed just and reasonable.
quotes: we also respectfully suggest that FERC examine interconnection study processes, and whether it should be considered not just and reasonable for an interconnection request to take longer than six months, as recently requested by thirteen governors of both parties.

letters.desc: GridCARE supports establishing an expedited or fast-track interconnection study pathway for loads that demonstrate verifiable flexibility, arguing that measurable flexibility commitments can reduce restudy risks and near-term constraints.
quotes: flexibility, when defined in measurable and verifiable terms, can help accelerate interconnections, reduce restudy risks, provide near-term operational headroom, and maintain reliability.

letters.desc: GridStor supports the ANOPR proposal to expedite study of curtailable and dispatchable loads and requests that expedited transmission service studies also apply to ESR charging, citing existing 60 to 90 day load interconnection timeframes as a model.
quotes: To the extent that the Commission seeks to develop rules to expedite transmission service studies of large loads that are flexible and curtailable, we respectfully request that such rules also enable speedy and timely transmission service studies of ESR charging.
Precedent exists in RTO/ISO tariffs for load interconnection processes that need no longer than 60-90 days to execute fully, and similar timeframes could be applied to ESR charging studies.

letters.desc: Helion calls for multiple expedited mechanisms: expedited study pathways for baseload and dispatchable resources, expedited approval for BTM and directly connected generation, and expedited review for novel generation technologies. These pathways are justified by grid reliability benefits and the need to match deployment speed to electricity demand growth.
quotes: FERC should establish clear criteria that recognize and prioritize baseload, dispatchable resources based on their contribution to grid reliability.
Expedited study pathways for resources providing baseload, dispatchable, non-fuel-limited power
Create expedited approval pathways for behind-the-meter or directly connected generation that reduces demand on shared grid infrastructure
Establish standards for real-time or near-instantaneous study results, particularly for projects with minimal transmission impact or those pairing loads with baseload, dispatchable generation
Create expedited review processes for novel generation technologies demonstrating baseload, dispatchable characteristics

letters.desc: Heron supports expedited interconnection study for grid-forming loads and preferential queue treatment for facilities with open, verifiable controls, on the basis that they impose materially lower study burdens.
quotes: The expedited study pathway the Commission is considering for flexible and curtailable loads is a natural starting point; grid-forming loads should qualify for comparable treatment.

The Commission should also explore preferential queue treatment or reduced study deposit requirements for such facilities, recognizing that the study burden those facilities impose on operators is materially lower.

letters.desc: The filer supports a priority processing track for interconnection applications at nodes with documented stiff-point characteristics, especially Rust Belt legacy industrial sites. Expedited preliminary qualification based on interconnection history addresses both queue congestion and geographic redistribution simultaneously, moving the highest-quality applications fastest.
quotes: The interconnection queue, which nationally had grown to over two thousand gigawatts of pending requests by 2024, with PJM accounting for a substantial share of that backlog, functions on a first-come, first-served allocation mechanism that rewards queue position rather than siting quality.

RTOs and ISOs should establish a priority processing track for large-load interconnection applications at nodes with demonstrated stiff-point characteristics. Legacy heavy industrial sites in the Rust Belt corridor that carried industrial loads of comparable or greater magnitude within the past thirty years should be eligible for expedited preliminary qualification based on documented interconnection history.

letters.org: Industrial Energy Consumers of America et al.
letters.desc: The filers propose an optional federal fast-lane process called XL Connect for loads with urgent speed-to-power needs. Qualifying loads would pay full upgrade costs in exchange for a 90-day study timeline, face stricter credit and flexibility requirements, and still retain a distribution utility connection to satisfy state jurisdictional requirements.
quotes: the Industrial Customer Organizations respectfully propose that the Commission consider developing an elective, "fast-lane" interconnection approach that addresses regional transmission and resource adequacy impacts without cutting out the distribution utility or violating state-level tariffs.
XL Connect is an optional federal, fast-lane interconnection process for a large load connecting to the FERC-jurisdictional transmission system at transmission-level voltage.

letters.desc: iMasons backs expedited interconnection treatment for large flexible loads as a way to address speed-to-power concerns for data centers without burdening the broader interconnection queue.
quotes: iMasons supports a final rule that accelerates the interconnection of large loads that voluntarily agree to be curtailable and dispatchable (i.e., flexible), provided that existing interconnection queues are not unduly and unjustly disrupted.

letters.desc: IFP supports expedited interconnection for curtailable loads and urges that security standard adherence be a precondition for receiving that expedited pathway, turning speed-to-power benefits into an incentive for security hardening.
quotes: The most powerful proposal for immediate impact is Principle 7, which proposes that 'the interconnection study of large loads that agree to be curtailable... should be expedited.'
the US grid could integrate "76 GW of new load" with minimal expansion of the existing power system.

The Commission should use this rulemaking to mandate such reliability and, crucially, security standards – both cyber and physical – and ensure they attach to large loads that seek accelerated interconnection.
Adherence to these new, robust security standards should be a non-negotiable precondition for any large load to receive the 'speed-to-power' benefits (Principle 7) proposed in this ANOPR.

letters.desc: IECA frames the entire rulemaking around speed to market and keeping Data Center investment onshore, endorsing expedited review for curtailable and dispatchable facilities and arguing that expedited access should not be restricted by size.
quotes: we believe the public interest is best served by creating a regulatory framework in which large loads, focusing primarily on large Data Centers, can be developed expeditiously in the U.S. to ensure that: (A) Data Center development does not move offshore to other countries with a more Data Center-friendly regulatory environment; and (B) the U.S. continues to be a leader in the global race to both develop and implement AI and other advanced computing capabilities.

for purposes of expediting interconnection to the transmissions system (i.e., enhancing "speed to market"), we submit that expedited review and approval should be available to all loads (i.e., all Data Centers), not just large Data Centers in excess of any particular size.

letters.desc: IECA supports expediting large load interconnection through voluntary guidance that developers can follow to meet commercial deadlines. It opposes attaching curtailability conditions to expedited approval pathways.
quotes: Instead, we submit that the Commission would do the most good by proposing guidance which developers of Data Centers and developers of new power plants could voluntarily pursue as a means of expediting the regulatory approvals required to meet the commercial deadlines of Data Centers and AI developers and users.

We support the simultaneous study of system impacts from a Co-Located Load with its Co-Located Generation and the expeditious approval of the interconnection of both at a single point of interconnection or at two or more "proximate" points of interconnection, provided that the impacts on the transmission grid and other users of that transmission grid are addressed as set forth in Section III.B. of these Reply Comments.
we do not support requiring curtailability of Data Center load as a condition to expedited interconnection of large loads, whether such large loads are Co-Located Loads or stand-alone large loads.

Excluding such applications of Data Centers and AI from expedited interconnection approval, because such applications are unable to be curtailed, would not benefit the public interest and would be harmful to the public interest, which we believe is served by expediting and encouraging the development and application of such Data Centers, AI, and other similarly high-reliability large loads.

letters.org: Invenergy Wind Development North America LLCInvenergy Solar Development North America LLCInvenergy Thermal Development Holdings LLC ,
letters.desc: Pending a comprehensive combined-queue regime, Invenergy proposes an expedited interconnection process for loads that have already contracted with a generator. This interim path provides a prompt avenue for ready projects while FERC develops holistic rules.
quotes: The Commission should also clarify that high voltage, direct current ("HVDC") solutions should be treated as equivalent to co-located generation in the integrated study process, including any expedited study process for co-located (or hybrid) projects.
the Commission could issue rules creating an expedited interconnection process for load that has contracted with a generator.

letters.desc: The filing supports faster and more predictable large load interconnection as a shared goal, while emphasizing it should be achieved through existing customer-protective frameworks.
quotes: We share the Administration's commitment to energy dominance and specifically support improving the speed, efficiency, fairness, and predictability of large load interconnections.

letters.desc: LS Power supports an expedited interconnection path but says it should be limited to facilities where generation fully matches the load's capacity and energy needs. The expedited track for curtailable facilities must include operational constraints and must not allow curtailment to undermine market price signals.
quotes: Large load interconnection rules should provide an expedited process for generation paired with co-located new large load. In order to qualify for expedited interconnection consideration, the large load must bring generation that matches its maximum capacity and energy needs.

Hybrid facilities interconnecting on an expedited basis (deferred transmission upgrades) can be fully curtailable. If associated generation is not providing sufficient energy for its load, then the load cannot look to the grid for its energy and if load is less than the generation supply, the generation may not come onto the grid (other than emergency dispatch).

letters.desc: Maryland supports expedited interconnection studies for large loads and hybrids that are curtailable and dispatchable, viewing well-designed voluntary pathways as effective incentives. However, expedited processing must not disrupt PJM's generation interconnection queue.
quotes: MEA believes well-designed voluntary pathways to faster interconnection can provide effective incentives
MEA urges that any expediting of interconnection studies of large loads ensure minimal disruption to PJM's generation interconnection process

letters.desc: Meta strongly supports expedited interconnection for co-located large loads and generation but opposes conditioning expedited treatment on curtailment requirements. The company argues that data centers require firm continuous power and that coordination of load and generation enables them to meet power demands without curtailment commitments.
quotes: Meta strongly supports expedited review of facilities that co-locate large loads and generation. Co-location allows large loads to secure electric power quickly, and, in some instances, streamline the build out of necessary transmission infrastructure

utilities should not limit expedited processes to only large loads or hybrid facilities 'that agree to be curtailable', which is discussed in paragraph 24 of the ANOPR. This limitation would be incompatible with the operational requirements of many data centers, which often allow for little downtime over the course of the year
Coordination of new load and incremental new generation allows data centers to meet their power demands without resorting to curtailment commitments and therefore warrants expedited study

letters.desc: Microsoft agrees voluntarily curtailable loads make sense and supports an expedited study process for curtailable loads and dispatchable hybrid facilities. It conditions that support on not creating reliability risks and not interfering with interconnection of critical nonflexible large loads.
quotes: Microsoft agrees that regulatory frameworks that allow for voluntarily curtailable loads make sense and will be an important tool for accelerating the deployment of critical AI infrastructure.

Microsoft believes an expedited study process for curtailable loads and dispatchable hybrid facilities would be appropriate and consistent with the interests of the administration, so long as these arrangements do not create operational reliability risks and do not interfere with the interconnection of critical nonflexible large loads.

letters.desc: If the Commission proceeds, the MISO Transmission Owners ask that any new rules apply only to future load additions and that loads already in the process of interconnecting be grandfathered. They request at least one year before any reforms take effect.
quotes: any such reforms should be solely limited to new load additions or future requests to increase the size of existing loads.  Existing or new large load additions that are currently being considered should also be grandfathered and not subject to the reforms.

letters.desc: The filing supports an expedited interconnection option for large loads that bring their own new generation, viewing this as the most effective mechanism to align load entry with reliability.
quotes: The best incentive to bring only real projects is to provide an expedited option to bring your own new generation. This incentive would be much stronger and more effective and more focused on a real solution than requiring deposits.

letters.org: National Association of Regulatory Utility Commissioners
letters.desc: NARUC argues states can act more nimbly and expeditiously than RTO stakeholder processes or Section 206 FERC proceedings, which lack the statutory deadlines state commissions face.
quotes: All these examples demonstrate that states can be nimble in addressing large load interconnection issues.  By necessity, processes within RTOs, relying as they do on stakeholder consultation, are far less expeditious.

letters.desc: National Grid calls for a transition period that allows projects already in advanced stages under existing retail interconnection rules to continue without reevaluation under new criteria. This mirrors the approach used in Order No. 2023 and protects investment-backed expectations.
quotes: Establishing a reasonable transition period is essential to ensure a smooth regulatory shift while maintaining continuity for large load interconnection projects already in advanced stages under retail interconnection procedures.

letters.org: Natural Resource Defense CouncilSustainable FERC ProjectClean Air Task Force ,Coalition for Affordable Utility Services and Energy Efficie ,EARTHJUSTICE ,ENVIRONMENTAL DEFENSE FUND ,MONTANA ENVIRONMENTAL INFORMATION CENTER ,Sierra Club ,Southern Environmental Law Center ,
letters.desc: The filers support expedited interconnection for curtailable loads but warn against fast-track paths that harm the existing generator queue. They prefer accelerating interconnection processes broadly over creating separate fast-track lanes.
quotes: FERC should emphasize accelerating interconnection processes generally over adopting separate fast-tracks, and must at least implement safeguards to prevent fast-tracks from causing harm to the existing generator interconnection process.
76 GW of new load—equivalent to 10% of the nation's current aggregate peak demand—could be integrated with an average annual load curtailment rate of 0.25%.

letters.desc: Ohio FEA points to existing state-level expedited processes in Ohio where data centers can request studies within 45-60 days and sign agreements within 60 days as a model that has already begun working.
quotes: the PUCO has already begun working with regulated utilities in Ohio to create an orderly and expedited process by which new data center loads can request interconnection studies and an electric service agreement

letters.desc: OpenAI wants designated national-interest projects to receive a required fast-track interconnection process, and supports expedited treatment for loads that accept curtailment.
quotes: OpenAI supports an approach that allows the DOE to identify and provide a "national-interest" designation for loads above 250 MW that have clear national interest or security,economicimperativeorcompetitiveness,orcritical-infrastructurevalue
Transmission providers shouldthenberequiredtoexpeditetheinterconnectionofthesedesignatedprojects through a fast track process.
OpenAIsupportsanoptionalcurtailable-loadpathwaywherefullorpartialcurtailment obligations of the large loads allow thetransmissionprovidertoexpeditetheinterconnection request.

letters.desc: Oracle supports streamlining Commission processes to incentivize AI infrastructure growth and deployment.
quotes: Oracle strongly supports the White House's commitment to win the 'race to achieve global dominance in artificial intelligence (AI)' and encourages the Commission to bolster U.S. AI dominance by streamlining processes and incentivizing growth for infrastructure deployment both in the United States and in trusted partner/allied nations.

letters.desc: Paces supports expedited treatment and recommends a mandatory SLA of under 20 business days for initial studies. It argues that AI automation is the only way to meet such a timeline at scale, and that the fastest interconnection track should be reserved for dispatchable loads sited at power-ready buses.
quotes: interconnection studies up to 20x faster with full audit trails and sign-off

State that transmission providers are encouraged to use AI agents to operate approved study tools and scripts, as long as qualified engineers own the methodology and sign-off and workflows are auditable.
Encourage or require a SLA of <20 business days for all large load initial studies which makes the leveraging of AI automation essential to meet such a timeline.
sited at buses with positive headroom and nearby developable land
Permit slower timelines and clearer upgrade expectations for heavily constrained, non-power-ready locations.

letters.org: Pennsylvania Office of Consumer AdvocateDelaware Division of the Public AdvocateIllinois Office of Attorney General ,
letters.desc: The filers support expedited interconnection for facilities that commit to curtailment or dispatch, but insist those commitments must be verifiable, enforceable, and subject to penalties. They oppose any caps on the number of curtailment events, arguing such caps shift risk onto other customers who did not receive the expedited treatment.
quotes: any curtailable or dispatchable commitments made by large loads and hybrid facilities must be verifiable, enforceable, and subject to penalties for non-performance. There should not be limits on the number of curtailable events or the number of times for curtailments as some request.

letters.org: PSEG CompaniesPSEG Energy Resources & Trade LLCPSEG Power LLC ,Public Service Electric and Gas Company ,
letters.desc: PSEG calls for an expedited interconnection track specifically for state-sponsored generation to address the growing supply gap in PJM and other regions before large load growth fully materializes.
quotes: there is an urgent need to create an expedited interconnection track to bring state-sponsored resources online faster.

letters.desc: RSI supports accelerating interconnection for load configurations that combine wholesale market participation with resource adequacy benefits, distinguishing them from demand-only loads that do not warrant the same priority.
quotes: accelerating the interconnection of these load-and-FERC-jurisdictional-service configurations is warranted, given their outsized contribution to resource adequacy and limiting the impact on the broader transmission network.

letters.desc: Rewiring America supports expedited interconnection study and concurrent study processes for large loads with accompanying flexibility resources, when evaluated under performance-based standards. This aligns with recommendations that DERs within VPPs should be eligible for accelerated review where they meet locational and deliverability requirements.
quotes: A performance-based approach to concurrent study and expedited large load interconnection ensures that flexibility resources are eligible and credited for providing transmission relief, while remaining technology-neutral and consistent with Order 2222.

Rewiring America strongly supports The Pew Charitable Trusts' recommendation that "DERs within a VPP should be eligible [for concurrent study and expedited large load interconnection] where they satisfy appropriate locational and deliverability requirements."

letters.desc: Shell Energy supports expedited interconnection pathways but insists they be framed as options for interim operations while full studies complete, not permanent operational restrictions. Large loads must retain the right to seek full grid access through standard processes.
quotes: The principles should not be requirements for large loads to interconnect under permanent operational restrictions; instead, should be interpreted as options that can expedite initial interconnections and allow for interim operations while full studies and transmission construction activities are completed if large loads need full grid access.

letters.desc: SMA states that curtailability and dispatchability required for expedited study are already field-proven using standard protocols such as IEEE 2030.5. Compliance should be assessed at the interconnection point rather than component by component.
quotes: Controllability (in particular curtailability and dispatchability) with SMA technology is already field-proven and state-of-the-art (system operators can manage it) using, for example, the IEEE 2030.5 (SEP2) protocol.
Preferably, controllability should be assessed at the interconnection point rather than at individual components, allowing owners maximum flexibility in implementation.

letters.desc: SMECO supports expedited interconnection studies for large loads that agree to be dispatchable, provided that PJM retains adequate ability to control such facilities through curtailment and dispatch mechanisms such as Price Responsive Demand and Demand Response products.
quotes: SMECO urges the Commission, in any final rule, to ensure that PJM's ability to control such eligible load facilities through curtailment and/or dispatch, through, for example PJM Price Responsive Demand and Demand response products, to the extent those or similar products is permitted at all to serve new large loads, is adequate for PJM to integrate the facility into both operations and system planning.

letters.org: Southwest Power Pool Transmission Owner Group
letters.desc: HILL's 90-day expedited study and the pending CHILLS proposal together provide a fast path for curtailable large loads and proximate generation. The filer asks FERC to approve CHILLS and recognize these processes as sufficient.
quotes: The HILL reform provides a 90-day expedited review process for generation projects in close electrical proximity to the load they are meant to serve.
The SPP TO Group strongly support CHILLS and recommends that the Commission approve that proposal as a valuable, region-specific means of expediting curtailable load interconnections.

letters.desc: Splight supports expedited interconnection study for large loads with advanced contingency response capability, arguing they should be studied as firm loads when transmission capacity is the limiting factor. The company emphasizes that response times under 500 milliseconds justify faster processing.
quotes: Splight strongly supports this principle and respectfully urges the Commission to go further by explicitly recognizing the value of large loads that implement advanced, automated contingency response technologies ("Fast-Responding Loads") as a basis for both (1) expedited interconnection and (2) allocation of increased capacity in proportional to the speed and amount of curtailment a load is able to provide.

Where transmission adequacy is the fundamental limitation, Fast-Responding Loads should be studied based on their ability to modify demand near-instantaneously in the event of a transmission system failure (for example, Splight's DCM can respond in less than 500 milliseconds) and, should be considered for expedited interconnection as firm loads.

letters.desc: Talen favors faster action through existing dockets with developed records rather than a slow new rulemaking, and asks FERC to direct PJM to expedite interconnection of resources selected under the backstop auction.
quotes: FERC can issue orders in any of the pending proceedings that already have fully developed records on a much faster timeline.
the Commission should direct PJM to develop a Reliability Resource Initiative-like interconnection process which will expedite the interconnection of all resources selected under the RBA mechanism.

letters.desc: Tesla wants capacity additions behind the same POI that offset generation loss to serve load permitted through expedited review, and frames its Gigafactory case as evidence of the need for faster, more predictable interconnection.
quotes: Tesla believes that capacity additions behind the same POI that offset generation “loss” to serve load should be permitted with expedited reviews, assuming the system maintains consistent or similar POI import/export limitations.

This experience highlights a broader need to establish greater clarity, efficiency, and predictability in the interconnection process as large load growth driven by manufacturing facilities and data centers continues at a rapid pace.

letters.desc: Pew supports expedited interconnection pathways for curtailable large loads and contends those pathways must be available to loads contracting with VPPs. VPPs' rapid deployment speed makes them especially suited to the expedited-study objective.
quotes: Adopting rules that allow integrated, expedited study of large loads that contract with VPPs will facilitate speed-to-power for large load customers while keeping transmission and energy affordable for existing customers.

VPPs, by contrast, do not depend on proceeding through the large generator interconnection queue. As Distributed Capacity Parties explain, '[d]istributed capacity assets are installed today across critical footprints, are readily installable en masse, and may be aggregated into utility-scale assets on a timeline of months rather than years'

letters.desc: TBA recommends that loads with enforceable, asset-backed flexibility commitments receive expedited interconnection treatment and queue priority, because they pose lower system risk during grid stress than inflexible high-load-factor customers.
quotes: Allowing large flexible loads the ability to connect expeditiously, manage their wholesale risks and commit to dispatchability will support a more affordable, resilient grid for all customers.
The Commission should require transmission providers to provide such loads with expedited interconnection treatment by giving them queue priority.

Queue priority is appropriate because loads that can demonstrate asset-backed flexibility pose substantially lower system risks during periods of grid stress and should therefore be eligible for accelerated review.

letters.desc: TBA argues that expedited interconnection is only feasible for loads on a non-firm or conditional basis, and that the record supports limiting expedited study treatment to fully curtailable or dispatchable loads.
quotes: commenters overwhelmingly agree that large loads capable of providing durable, enforceable flexibility should be eligible for expedited interconnection pathways
such expedited treatment is only feasible when the interconnecting load takes service on a non‑firm or conditional basis

the absence of a clear, Commission‑directed, non‑firm service option risks perpetuating unreasonable and inefficient outcomes, including the misallocation of upgrade costs to loads that do not contribute to system peaks

only loads that are "completely curtailable or dispatchable" should qualify for expedited interconnection study treatment, underscoring that the depth of flexibility determines whether a project can be evaluated without peak-driven upgrades

letters.desc: Tract endorses fast-tracking interconnection studies for loads that commit to curtailability or dispatchability, suggesting a 60-day study target using cluster or serialized queue processes.
quotes: Tract agrees with the proposal to expedite the interconnection study of large loads that agree to be curtailable and hybrid facilities that agree to be curtailable and dispatchable.

letters.desc: The filer supports an expedited interconnection pathway and argues energy storage is uniquely positioned to make loads curtailable and flexible enough to qualify for it.
quotes: The ANOPR’s proposal to expedite interconnection studies for large loads and hybrid facilities that agree to be curtailable and dispatchable can, if implemented effectively, significantly increase the pace of interconnection for large loads and their associated supply resources.
Energy storage is uniquely positioned as a rapid pathway for making loads curtailable and flexible, enabling them to potentially seek and obtain expedited interconnection.

letters.desc: UCS supports expediting interconnection studies for curtailable and dispatchable loads but insists that any rulemaking define the specific terms of curtailment to avoid disputes and implementation delays. A clear non-firm economic dispatch designation is the recommended path.
quotes: the Commission should propose rules that both supply (in the case of a hybrid interconnection) and the load will need to commit to respond to operator dispatch instructions. That commitment should indicate both the duration and the quantity of the response, in either megawatts or percentage of the injection and withdrawal rights.

Any forthcoming rule from the Commission must include criteria for determining the amount and the duration of curtailment and/or dispatch to avoid controversy and delay in the adoption of this principle.

The most direct approach compatible with existing grid operator dispatch is to have both the supply and demand from such interconnection customers be designated as non-firm and subject to economic dispatch.

letters.desc: Vantage supports Principle 7's expedited interconnection study track for curtailable and dispatchable large loads, while urging caution on premature implementation of dispatchability requirements that could create reliability and regulatory problems for data center operators.
quotes: Vantage emphasizes that the specific principles and reforms concerning (1) hybrid interconnecting data center facilities supported in whole or in part by dedicated generating facilities (Principles 3 and 5), (2) expedited interconnection study procedures (Principle 7), (3) cost allocation for interconnection-related network upgrades (Principle 8), and (4) a fair and structured transition that respects existing rights (Principle 13) are of greatest importance.

Vantage is compelled to make significant investments in power plants, sometimes having to limit or forgo reliance on traditionally reliable grid-connected power due to load interconnection delays, shortages of available utility supply, or infeasible interconnection regulations requiring large new loads to be curtailable.

Vantage supports the objective of proposed ANOPR Principle 7 but encourages the Commission's cautious and thoughtful consideration of potential negative consequences of premature implementation of this Principle's dispatchability aspect.

A key determinant in securing such flexibility will hinge on the conditions of curtailment, which must be further developed through a collaborative process that addresses the economic and reliability concerns of data center customers, as well as those of electric utilities and retail electricity consumers.

letters.desc: VEIR asks FERC to create expedited study tracks for projects that reduce siting complexity or use compact, underground cable technologies. The filer also asks whether pilot or demonstration status for such technologies should merit expedited treatment.
quotes: The large-load interconnection regime can include both procedural mechanisms and technology-neutral performance standards (or incentives) that reward deployment of high-capacity, space-efficient systems. For example, expedited study tracks might apply for projects proposing such high-density conductors.

VEIR invites FERC to consider in the ANOPR stage: (a) whether study cost-allocation frameworks should recognize reduced ROW and environmental impact associated with innovative cable technology; (b) whether pilot or demonstration status of such technologies merits expedited interconnection treatment; and (c) how manufacturing scale-up of such systems may reduce long-lead supply-chain delays that currently hamper large-load attachments.

We ask FERC to consider creating a "low-impact interconnection study track" for projects that demonstrably reduce system or siting complexity—such as those using compact, underground, or non-emitting delivery technologies.

letters.desc: Verrus urges a dedicated expedited study track for verified flexible loads, with shorter timelines and modeling that reflects curtailment capability, so grid-supportive projects move through the queue faster.
quotes: The Commission should require a Fast-Lane Study Track for verified flexible loads, using shorter study timelines and modeling that accounts for their ability to curtail or shift load and to operate on-site resources.

letters.desc: Verrus urges FERC to implement a standardized expedited interconnection lane for loads with verifiable flexibility commitments. The filing cites CAISO's observation that curtailable facilities are generally easier to study and argues that fast-tracking simple projects clears the queue for everyone and is a strategic imperative for national competitiveness.
quotes: it forces these agile resources to wait in queues behind projects requiring years of costly upgrades, rather than allowing them to connect quickly by leveraging the underutilized non-peak grid capacity already in place.
a load should qualify for the "Flexible" subclass (and the associated fast-lane study) if it commits to curtailing the greater of 20 MW or 25% of its total load.

an expedited timeline is not discriminatory "queue jumping" as some commenters have suggested—it simply reflects the reduced time required to study a simpler project and the efficiency gains realized when faster projects are allowed to move at a faster pace.

Treating a flexible project that requires zero network upgrades with the same study duration as a massive, inflexible load that requires new transmission lines is, in itself, discriminatory. It delays the efficient project for no technical reason.

When a technical pathway exists to interconnect large loads quickly—because they do not require network upgrades—requiring them to proceed at the pace of the slowest, most complex projects is a policy error the country cannot afford.

letters.desc: The VSCC agrees that curtailable and dispatchable loads and hybrid facilities should receive expedited study treatment. Virginia is already holding a technical conference on data center load flexibility and a cooperative approach would let these state efforts continue.
quotes: the interconnection study of large loads that agree to be curtailable and hybrid facilities that agree to be curtailable and dispatchable should be expedited. Many states, including Virginia, are currently addressing data center load flexibility, and a cooperative approach in this proceeding would allow these efforts to proceed.
